text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Israeli newspapers on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- No agreement as Washington summit ends
- Palestinian boy dies near Hebron; Army preparing for possibility of fresh unrest.
- Netanyahu praises American Jewish group which has lobbied against PLO in Congresse.
- Israeli army coordinator in West Bank and Gaza says fresh gun battles between Israeli soldiers and Palestitnian police could wreck peace deal.
- Netanyahu, Arafat agree to non-stop talks.
- Netanyahu: "The ice has been broken with Arafat. We have complete trust in one another".
- Arafat to activists in the West Bank and Gaza: "Hold off. Don't renew the struggle".
- "Israel's plan to raise $200 million in foreign banks was postponed due to the situation".
- Meridor: Foreign investors are still interested in Israel; Frankel: There is concern over a possible halt in peace process.
